description: Election Commission - Declaring S. B. D. K. Shanaka as a member of the Wattala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Wattala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a seat that became vacant, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
